controls.negative_claim: invalid measures, unsupported tail dispatch, non-convergence and malformed evidence fail closed
missing/new/changed/deleted rows and corrupted fingerprints are rejected
truncation, study-README overwrite, dropped sections and reordering are rejected
an intentional production/study seam drift makes the parity detector fail
an intentional stored coefficient mutation makes the re-derivation fixture fail
rename, type/order, ByVal/ByRef, Optional/default, return type, additive API and module movement fail
changed source/grid/registry/schema bindings and malformed manifests are rejected
manifest-only rebinds fail unless they are a valid export or exact restoration
removing the reference helper forces the strict gate to block rather than silently downgrade
stale generated content is deterministically replaced and missing markers fail
restated threshold, accuracy, cap and envelope claims are detected while authoritative constants are allowed
metric/measure drift, unsupported dispatch and non-convergence cannot produce a verdict
candidate/source/workflow SHA drift, assertion drift, cleanup failure and false grid export hash/row/target claims are rejected

a destructive default generator run, reference output aimed at the committed grid, holdout or any observation-bearing copy, duplicate canonical keys, unacknowledged, miscounted or stale reference changes, unsanctioned appends or retirements, and a replaced observation during reference migration are all refused
whitespace errors in a committed candidate range, including the root commit and an explicit base, are rejected while staged and unstaged edits are kept separate
GoTo, GoSub and Resume targets outside the owning procedure, and duplicate labels, are rejected across every tracked VBA module
invalid SemVer, out-of-order or duplicated releases, impossible or regressing cut dates, a wrong or missing comparison link, and a latest release heading that disagrees with VERSION are rejected
